{{Quote|As far as I know, the ship's drifting in the ''Terminus'', the intersection of the ''Corellian Trade Spine'' and the ''Hydian Way''.|[[Lieutenant]] [[Kondra]]|<ref name="Bounty Hunters 8">[[Bounty Hunters 8|''Bounty Hunters'' 8]]</ref>}}
'''Terminus''' was an astronomical object located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]], and was the intersection of the [[Corellian Trade Spine]] and the [[Hydian Way]].<ref name="Beginner Game">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> The corridor was known to be infested with [[pirate]]s, including the [[Ohnaka Gang]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters 8" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Bounty Hunters 8|''Bounty Hunters'' 8]] to [[3 ABY]].</ref> the ''[[Spirit of Jedha]]'' dropped out of [[hyperspace]], and was trapped there.<ref name="Bounty Hunters 8" /> [[Droid Gotra]] began to transmit orders to all members of Gotra and the [[Cyban Front]] stationed in the Rim Territories, ordering them to strike high-value data caches on Terminus, [[Little Petrovi]], and [[Corbett Cluster]]. The transmission was promptly intercepted by the [[Guavian Death Gang]], who then broadcast their own counteracting broadcast.<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />
